chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) used to judge with one witness along with the oath of the owner of the right.
ai.seo_question: What is the evidentiary requirement for a judge to rule in favor of a claimant according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the principle of *shahid wa yamin* (single witness with oath), a foundational mechanism in Shia jurisprudence for resolving disputes where full proof is unavailable. It highlights the Prophet’s practical application of evidentiary standards, balancing the claimant’s sworn testimony with a single witness to ensure justice while maintaining procedural rigor.
